firm_data.firm_description: Leav & Steinberg LLP is a New York City-based personal injury law firm dedicated to helping victims of serious accidents. They provide client-focused legal counsel for people who have been in serious accidents caused by negligence.
notable_facts: Featured in New York Magazine as Personal Injury Litigators by the New York Law Journal in 2009 and 2010.
Attorneys are members of the New York State Trial Lawyers Association, the New York State Bar Association, the American Association of Justice, and the New York City Bar Association.
Mr. Leav and Mr. Steinberg are members of the top tier of attorneys in the Legal Referral Service of the New York City Bar Association.

email.subject: AI for Leav & Steinberg LLP, built for firms like yours
email.body:
Hi Daniela,

Leav & Steinberg's recognition in the New York Law Journal as a leading personal injury litigator caught my attention, especially given the complexity of medical malpractice and motor vehicle accident cases your firm handles.

I lead business at Lucio, an AI platform built for law firms that face BigLaw demands with leaner teams. We recently raised $5M, and firms across 9 jurisdictions have chosen us over Harvey because we focus on the realities of smaller practices: precision, client trust, and efficiency.

Having completed successful pilots on the East Coast, we're now arriving in New York to meet regional firms. I'd be happy to stop by your office to share how, as ex-lawyers ourselves, we're helping similar firms compete with BigLaw on document review and case analysis.

Worth 20 minutes?

Vasu
Lucio
